## Build Failure Analysis

### Solution Structure
```
BuildDiag.sln
├── Core/Core.csproj          (net8.0) — builds successfully
├── Services/Services.csproj  (net8.0) → references Core — FAILS
└── Api/Api.csproj            (net8.0) → references Services + Core — FAILS (cascading)
```

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**Missing NuGet package in `Services/Services.csproj`**

`Services/UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (`using Newtonsoft.Json;` and `JObject` type on line 22), but `Services.csproj` has **no `PackageReference`** to the `Newtonsoft.Json` package. The `project.assets.json` confirms only the `Core` project reference was restored — no packages.

All 3 errors (`CS0246` on lines 2, 3, 22) stem from this single missing dependency.

### Cascading Failure

`Api.csproj` depends on `Services.csproj`, so it also fails to build — but it has no errors of its own.

### Fix

Add the missing package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

Or run:
```bash
dotnet add Services/Services.csproj package Newtonsoft.Json
```
